rules.claim: All Tamp package ids follow Tamp.{ToolFamily}{.V{Major}}? — must start with the fixed brand prefix 'Tamp.'
The .V{Major} suffix tracks only a major (integer), not minor/patch — reject Tamp.*.V{N}_{N} style names.
.V{Major} is present only when the wrapped tool's CLI surface materially breaks across major versions; otherwise the tool family package is unpinned.
The version number after .V tracks the wrapped tool's major version, not the package's own NuGet semver.
